newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends mixed, IBM sparks tech-sector rally.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends mixed, IBM sparks tech-sector rally.

text.p: Many Nasdaq shares rallied Wednesday during a mixed session that saw International Business Machines Corp jump ahead of better-than-expected first-quarter earnings report, pushing other large technology stocks higher, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 14.41 points or 1.19 percent to 1227.15, contrasting a slight drop in the Dow industrials. The Nasdaq session was mixed, however, with declining issues beating advancing issues 2266 to 1852 on total volume of 592 million shares.

"The buzz about IBM helped the big names. Everyone was positive about IBM today, which made people feel safe buying other quality tech stocks. But otherwise, trading was a bit cautious," one trader said.
Intel Corp surged 5-3/8 to 146-1/4, Microsoft Corp jumped 4-1/2 to 115-1/8 and Oracle Corp added 2-1/2 to 37-3/4.

PeopleSoft Inc gained 7-5/8 to 42-5/8 after it said it expects its 1997 revenues to be up more than 70 percent over 1996. Peak Technologies Group Inc jumped 4-1/2 to 17-1/2 after its agreed to be acquired by Moore Corp Ltd.
